title: Excellent!
text: We loved this class. Antonio was wonderful. They accommodated special diets and the food was delicious!
author: 2BrunettesAnd1Blond

title: Great Class
text: This was a wonderful class!  Three couples, all strangers, enjoyed the group cooking experience.  Our instructor was very knowledgeable and outgoing.  Made the evening so much fun.  We highly recommend this class to everyone!
author: rvr7401

title: Amazing experience!
text: Such a fun and delicious class! We learned to make classic Spanish tapas and an incredible paella, all guided by a fantastic chef who made everything easy and enjoyable. The atmosphere was great, the food was amazing, and sharing it all with the group (plus some good wine!) made it even better. Highly recommend!
author: Carolina D

title: The best night out in Barcelona
text: From the moment I arrived and joined the group to the moment I left the experience was fabulous. I’ve been cooking for so many years but yet learnt so many new techniques and ideas. The food was amazing …. It was fun whilst drinking the wine and laughs with everybody. I would definitely recommend it to anybody wanting an evening of fun, smiles , education and laughs … Juan was great fun 🤩🥳
author: Philip P

title: Best experience in Barcelona!
text: We booked this cooking class last minute with no expectations, as it was our first time trying something like this—and it turned out to be absolutely incredible! It also happened to be my birthday, which made the experience even more special. From the tapas to the paella, and a never empty glass of cava our evening was perfect. Juan, our instructor, was not only hilarious but also extremely knowledgeable and detailed in teaching us how to prepare a traditional Catalonian meal. If we’re fortunate enough to return in the future, this will undoubtedly be at the top of our must-do list. Juan-in-a-
author: Q5530CJjulias

title: Great Tapas class with Sonia
text: We had a wonderful cooking class with Sonia! She was a delightful instructor and made everything so easy, clear, and delicious. The wine and cava was free-flowing and we enjoyed learning about recipes and ingredients we don't find in the US. Great location on La Rambla and a fantastic way to spend an evening in Barcelon!
author: cvilleholly

title: Juan-derful
text: Our instructor Juan was juan-derful and a joy to learn from. Can't recommend him enough. He taught us how to prepare a number of dishes such as gazpacho, spanish omelette, and seafood paella. The class was incredibly engaging and a great time with lots of wine flowing throughout.
author: justinlQ8519CD

title: Best Cooking Class in Barcelona
text: Sonia was an excellent instructor! Her cooking tips were helpful and the paella was delicious. The set up of the cooking school was perfect for each chef and easy to meet the other chefs
author: FellowTraveler329165

title: Cooking in Barcelona
text: Renata our chef has given us a comprehensive instructional experience where we learned a great deal about the cooking in Barcelona! She was so knowledgeable and personable and her personality showed her love of what she does! Her staff, especially Carolina and the kitchen clean up crews were spot on! Our group will always remember this experience as one of favorite excursions of our trip❤️
author: donnacP936BN

title: Phenomenal experience.
text: Shared the class with a great group of people. The chef was knowledgeable, personable, funny and kind. The food was excellent, the wine was unsurpassed and the recipes were authentic and easy to follow. Our chef showed us exactly how to prepare every item and every step (and the “why”, so it’s easier to remember why you’re doing great you’re doing!) I will definitely be trying to make some of these when I get home. Highly recommend!!!
author: Brigit M
